about: Player-facing release notes, oldest first. Every entry shows once in each player's notifications (after their first lesson). The newest entry is also sent as a phone alert to players who turned phone alerts on, at most once a day, unless it has "push": false. To announce an update, add an entry at the END with a new unique id. Optional "go": where tapping it leads: panel:<id> (trade, boutique, profile, seasons...), place:<name>, gallery, players, messages, balance.

updates.title: New: the Grind Grand hotel and Grind Mall
updates.body: A suite for the night and a rooftop infinity pool on the west street; the Grind Fresh supermarket, a food court and a cinema on the east street.

updates.title: New: the four seasons and climate change
updates.body: Snow in winter, orange trees in autumn. Open Seasons in the menu to see 2050 and 2100 on low and high emissions.

updates.title: New in Grind Park
updates.body: A roller coaster, two water slides, Grind Zoo with a safari tram, three holes of golf and a picnic lawn. Take the metro to Grind Park.

updates.title: New: a trip to orbit
updates.body: Grind Orbital flies from the coast past the runway. Book at the desk at the north end of the airport terminal.

updates.title: New: the party jet and the party yacht
updates.body: Charter Grind One in the airport lounge, or board the party yacht from the board by the harbour.

updates.title: New: Grind International Airport
updates.body: Take the metro to the Airport stop. Fly GA 101 in Economy, Business or First, out over the sea and across the whole city.

updates.title: New: Society Masterclasses
updates.body: Eight premium masterclasses at the Etiquette House: the wealth mindset, quiet luxury, signal and larping, fine dining, working the room, presence, first-class travel and negotiation.

updates.title: New: graduation 🎓
updates.body: Pass every course in the six Campus worlds to graduate in the Great Hall: cap and gown, your name called, a diploma to download and share.

updates.title: New: El Niño and La Niña
updates.body: Every few in-game years the Pacific warms or cools and the weather shifts. See either one now in Seasons.

updates.title: New: cliff climbing and skydiving
updates.body: At the airport: a guided 34 m sea-cliff climb past the spaceport, and a tandem skydive from the Grind Skydive desk by the hangar. Every step explained.

updates.title: New: Grind Surf School and the Art Gallery
updates.body: Learn to surf on the city beach. The Grind Art Gallery hangs famous NFTs read live from Ethereum, free to visit.

updates.title: New: your Web3 personality
updates.body: Profile reads how you play: your traits, best-fit roles and niches. Hire home staff, swim in pools, and share "A day in my Web3 life".

updates.title: New: The Pitch
updates.body: A promoter is selling a hot new coin outside the Conference Centre. Learn how a rug pull works, on practice money.

updates.title: New: invite players home
updates.body: See who is online, invite them to your home, chill, chat and dance together. Tap any resident to see their profile.

updates.title: New: My Gallery, selfies and skits
updates.body: The picture key beside the menu opens My Gallery: take screenshots and selfies, record skits with friends, then download or share them.

updates.title: New: live prices and the DeFi desk
updates.body: Coins, tokens and memecoins at real-time prices. Practise swaps, vaults, bridges, lending, borrowing and DAO votes with cash you earned.

updates.title: New: Couture in the Boutique
updates.body: Hand-beaded pearl and gold mini dresses, and jewelled bralettes with beaded mini skirts. Premium pieces.

updates.title: Smoother and sharper
updates.body: Fewer freezes, a lighter load on phones (steady 30 frames a second where a phone needs it), new cars and 4K on big screens.

updates.title: Zahra keeps you on track
updates.body: Turn on phone alerts in Messages and Zahra will remind you when your next course is waiting. Dance is now in the Players list (move to stop).

updates.title: Messages got better
updates.body: Edit or delete your own messages (tap ⋯), drag through voice notes, and see a photo before you send it. Player profiles have a fresh look, and the joystick now sits bottom right.

updates.title: Never miss a notification
updates.body: A red number on the menu key shows what is unread, and new notifications slide in at the top. Tap to open them.

updates.title: New: chats that feel like a real messaging app
updates.body: Chats and the Messages list now show each player's own character as their picture. A chat fills the screen with a slim message bar, and Add friend, Block and Report sit on the player's profile: tap their name at the top of a chat.

updates.title: New: the Grand Masjid and prayer times
updates.body: A grand masjid with a golden dome, blue tiles and two minarets now stands by the basin. The five daily prayers show in real time for your city, with Jumuʿah on Fridays: open the menu, tap Prayer, and turn on reminders so you never miss one.

updates.title: New: lovelier faces and beautiful course cards
updates.body: Every resident now has clearer skin, defined eyes and a soft natural glow, with every skin tone kept true. Each course and career has its own rich illustration, and locked courses show a preview of what is coming.

updates.title: Send videos and documents, see who you play with
updates.body: Chats now take videos and documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) with the paperclip, show a red count on the Messages key, and open from a phone alert. Players online and Friends & party show everyone's character, a ride shows how long is left, and picking a place on the map shows your route there.

updates.title: New: starter cars you can save up for
updates.body: The Auto dealership now sells two starter cars: a coral City hatch and a pearl-blue Family sedan, priced so a new player can afford one after a few days of job duties, practice and check-ins. Test drive free, and once it is yours it waits outside your house and races on the circuit.

updates.title: Sturdier swings, a play tower, every place on the map
updates.body: The park swings now stand on proper frames joined at the top, and the slide is a play tower with a roof and a real chute. The map's list of places now has every place, the park and the airport included, with the park's rides kept under the park.

updates.title: Pass your first lesson, see your certificate at once
updates.body: Finish your first lesson with Zahra or on Campus and your CV opens with the course on it, with your new certificate on top, ready to share, download or mint.

updates.title: Performance: Auto, Light or Full, on phones and computers
updates.body: Settings now has one Performance choice for every device. Auto reads your phone or computer and eases the graphics down if frames run slow; Light is the smoothest; Full keeps every detail without freezing. Computers also draw a sharper, clearer city.

updates.title: Your proof comes first on your profile
updates.body: Your profile now opens with what you have done: courses passed, certificates and worlds finished, with Share my CV one tap away from your very first course. A Skills section shows your progress through each Campus world, and the day card leads with the courses you passed.

updates.title: Skits up to 10 minutes, saved in full
updates.body: Record a skit for up to 10 minutes and the whole take is kept, start to finish, and plays back at its full length in My Gallery. Long enough for TikTok, Reels and X.

updates.title: Gas, Brake, Horn and auto-drive
updates.body: At the wheel you now have Gas, Brake and Horn keys beside the steering stick (Space brakes and H honks on a keyboard). In your own car, pick any place on the map and the car drives you there by itself; touch the stick or a pedal to take the wheel back.

updates.title: Career mentors on the street
updates.body: Residents who work in a Web3 career (traders, builders, security nerds, creators and more) now mentor it. Tap one for a short tip from their path and the lesson they would set you next, with a Start button.

updates.title: Watch an auto race at the Raceway
updates.body: At the Raceway, Watch an auto race puts four cars on the circuit, yours on autopilot. Sit back and watch, or touch the stick or Gas to take the wheel and race it out.

updates.title: Grind Cab and Grind Premium
updates.body: No car yet? On the city map choose Travel by Cab ($4) or Premium ($9), then tap a place: a car pulls up at the nearest kerb and drives you there through the streets. Tap Stop here to hop out early. Quick travel and the Metro still work as before.

updates.title: Trade: type your own amount, P2P in your money, stake USDC and USDT
updates.body: On Spot you can now type an exact amount: dollars when buying (the coin you get shows as you type) or the coin when selling (the dollars show as you type). P2P now quotes in your own currency, such as naira, cedis or shillings, at the live rate. Stake also takes USDC and USDT from your earned cash.

updates.title: Lessons: Zahra reads the exercises, and P2P now covers fiat
updates.body: With lesson voice on, Zahra now reads each exercise question and its choices too. The P2P lesson explains fiat money and how P2P differs from OTC, and the scams lesson explains approval checkers like Revoke.cash, said properly at last.

updates.title: Trading floor: live walls, and every desk trades
updates.body: The trading floor's walls now show the same prices and day moves as the Trade screen, updated while you are there, and only coins you can actually trade. Sit at any desk and the trading screens open.

updates.title: Campus is tidier: finished worlds fold away
updates.body: Each world on Campus now folds under its header. Finished worlds close with a tick, the world you are on stays open, and a passed lesson has a Next lesson key so you never have to scroll to find it.

updates.title: Travel lands on the place, not a black screen
updates.body: Tapping a place on the map now shows the place itself when you arrive, with its panel opening a moment later, instead of a dark or frozen screen.

updates.title: Unit 4 has a job now
updates.body: Unit 4, the city's labelled AI agent, stops and turns to greet you when you walk up. Ask it what agents are, how many are in the city right now, and jump to the AI agents lesson.

updates.title: Lessons: clearer pictures, trading terms, a line to remember
updates.body: Lessons now open with their own illustrations instead of stock photos. Spot trading explains the trade screen, perps and futures, slippage, priority fees, market makers and arbitrage. Every lesson ends with one line to remember before the quick check.

updates.title: DeFi desk: Bridge and cross-chain in one place
updates.body: On the DeFi desk, Bridge now holds both moves: Same token (USDC on Base to USDC on Arbitrum) or Swap across chains (USDC on Base to SOL on Solana), with the difference explained in one tap. Swap and Bridge are tidier on phones.

updates.title: 30 coins on the Trade screen, with search
updates.body: Sixteen more major coins are on the Trade screen at live prices, including Cardano, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Uniswap, Aave, Cosmos, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and Stellar. Type a name or symbol in the new search box to find one fast.

updates.title: Zahra talks with her hands
updates.body: Zahra at Campus now waves when you say hello, points out what she shows you on the tour, and nods and gestures while she talks, in every language.

updates.title: New: the Graduation Garden at Campus
updates.body: The lawns in front of Campus now grow a banner each time players across the city pass a milestone of courses. The board shows how many courses everyone has passed so far and when the next banner goes up.

updates.title: New: huge halls, full of people
updates.body: The Campus lecture hall and the conference centre are now much bigger and always busy. Students fill the benches while a lecturer teaches, and the conference has a speaker, a panel and an audience. A few aisle seats are kept free for you.

updates.title: Paved forecourts and proper road ends
updates.body: Roads now end in turning circles before each district hall instead of running up to the doors, and every building stands on terracotta paving. The conference centre is taller too.

updates.title: New: Campus and the conference centre, rebuilt
updates.body: Campus now has two lecture theatres with stepped rows so everyone sees the board, two classrooms and a library off a corridor. The conference centre has a lobby, a raked auditorium, a panel room and a workshop room, all busy with people.

updates.title: Sit anywhere by walking up
updates.body: Stop beside any free seat, bench or chair in the city and you sit down by yourself. In the halls, walk up an aisle and stop at a row. You can also climb onto the conference stage and take the lectern.

updates.title: Rooms open fast, and you come back where you left off
updates.body: Going into a room or home no longer keeps the screen dark for seconds. When you come back to the game, you are inside the room or home you were in, not out on the plaza.

updates.title: Share your certificate in one tap
updates.body: Your certificate now has Post on X and Cast on Farcaster buttons, and on phones Share image, which sends the certificate picture itself.

updates.title: New: McGrind, open day and night
updates.body: A green burger, fries, shawarma and boba restaurant by the Campus café. Order a meal when you are hungry, or work a shift in the kitchen: fry, grill, wrap and pour to each order, serve the line for tips, and save your pay for bills and the next bull run.

updates.title: New: Grind Market, rent a stall and sell
updates.body: A covered market hall next to the Members lounge. Rent a stall for a day, stock it with suya, jollof, plantain chips, phone cases, tees or art prints, set your price, and sell to the city and to other players who are online.

updates.title: A fresh look at the city
updates.body: The opening picture and the link preview now show the city as it is today: paved forecourts, the Graduation Garden, McGrind and the sea.

updates.title: McGrind is hiring, all over town
updates.body: Look out for McGrind's billboards, bus shelter ads, A-frame boards and posters: "Bear market? We're hiring." Work a shift by the Campus café and stack your pay for the bull run.

updates.title: A tidier city stats card
updates.body: Tap the Online pill: the city's numbers now sit in a neat card with the headline figures on top and short sections below.

updates.title: New masterclass: Posture and Poise
updates.body: Stand, sit and walk like you belong in any room. A new paid masterclass at the Etiquette House, which now has a fresh look with an icon for every class.

updates.title: People talk with their faces now
updates.body: Zahra, residents, lecturers, staff and the kiosk server move their lips and hands when they speak, and turn to face you while you talk.

updates.title: Live lectures on Campus
updates.body: The lecture boards light up and move through their slides while the lecturers teach. Grab a seat in Theatre A or B.

updates.title: Smoother after switching apps
updates.body: If the 3D view comes back blank after you switch apps, the game now repairs it by itself. Also: a cleaner wallet card in the menu and a proper seat at the kiosk stools.

updates.title: New: share the city stats as a picture
updates.body: Tap the Online pill, then Share the city stats. You get a ready-made card with the live numbers and a link to play; on phones it goes straight into your share sheet, no saving needed.

updates.title: Share McGrind's posters
updates.body: Walk up to any McGrind poster, billboard or board and tap Share poster. The poster picture goes with your post.

updates.title: New: Barakah Club, halal nights
updates.body: Mocktails at the bar, a dance floor that lights up, a DJ, ludo with friends and a quiet prayer corner. No alcohol, ever. West of the Stockholders' Club.

updates.title: New: Grind Bank
updates.body: See how crypto banks keep your coins safe, practise with two spot crypto ETFs at live prices, and open a halal profit-sharing savings account. Earned cash only.

updates.title: Web3 From Zero, on every Campus board
updates.body: The boards in the Campus theatres and classrooms, and the conference stage screen, now run the Web3 From Zero slides: the internet, crypto, AI, earning and real-world assets, from the very beginning.

updates.title: Barakah Club: dinner with friends
updates.body: Barakah Club is now a place to gather and eat together: tables for four, jollof, suya and hot tea from the counter, and a quiet prayer corner.

updates.title: Grind Bank: how crypto institutions work
updates.body: The teller now walks you through crypto institutions: exchanges, custodians and crypto banks, how they keep your coins and what a proof of reserves shows.

updates.title: Smoother driving camera
updates.body: The camera no longer jumps in behind your car when you drive past street lamps.

updates.title: City stats, upgraded
updates.body: Tap the Online pill: the totals so far, the city, learning, and everything on-chain on Base and NEAR together. Share it as a picture with a ready-to-post caption.

updates.title: McGrind kitchen, hands-on
updates.body: Work a shift and watch your hands drop the fries, flip the patty, shave the shawarma and pour the drinks, then slide the tray to each customer. Taps now answer the moment you press.

updates.title: Café: today's board in plain words
updates.body: The Campus café and the Internet café now explain each line of market talk and what it means for you, and serve coffee, tea and meat pies.

updates.title: Carbon desk, explained
updates.body: What a carbon credit is, the three questions a good one answers, and what to check on each project before you make a practice pledge.

updates.title: Influencer Row: a bounty board by the door
updates.body: Post your bounty from the new board just inside the studio, or anywhere on the set. The framed covers no longer hang over the exit.

updates.title: Gym: easier to use, dumbbells count
updates.body: Stations answer from further away, the dumbbell rack is a station now, and any four of the five make today's set.

updates.title: Your Web3 persona is back
updates.body: Your profile reads your Web3 persona again: your traits, the roles that fit you and your corner of Web3, from how you play.

updates.title: Profile: clearer numbers, tidier sharing
updates.body: Courses passed, certificates and worlds finished are easy to read, and Invite and share is now two neat boxes: invite friends, and cards to share.

updates.title: Daily quests: no daily trade
updates.body: Trading is not an everyday habit, so it is no longer a daily quest. A trade still keeps your streak going.

updates.title: Fixes: seats and the Players list
updates.body: Changing rooms always stands you up first, so nobody ends up sitting on the floor by a door. The Dance button is gone from Players online.

updates.title: The Earning Map is open to everyone
updates.body: World 5 on Campus opens from day one: short lessons on the real ways people earn in Web3. Finish it to open Careers and jobs.

updates.title: McGrind: walk straight in
updates.body: A ceiling lamp used to fill the screen as you walked into McGrind and some other rooms. The lamps now hang out of the way, and McGrind, Grind Market, Grind Bank and Barakah Club are on the city map.

updates.title: New here? A beginner's guide
updates.body: Tap “New here? How it works” on the start screen for a step-by-step guide, and share it with friends: www.grinddistrict.app/how-it-works

updates.title: New: Grind Café ☕
updates.body: The Campus café is now Grind Café: a glass café you can see into and walk into, with a barista, people at the tables and a terrace. McGrind's patio is full of people eating outside too.

updates.title: Masjid: a women's section
updates.body: The Grand Masjid now has a women's section behind a carved screen. Sisters can pray on their own, or join the imam's congregation through the speakers. And you now pray in full: standing, bowing, prostrating and sitting.

updates.title: Messages: quick replies
updates.body: Above the typing box, one tap sends a greeting, a thanks or a thumbs-up, and the suggestions follow what was just said.

updates.title: Who's that? Cards as you pass
updates.body: Walk past a resident or a real player and a small card shows who they are: their name, what they do and what they're up to. Tap it for their full profile.

updates.title: Real plants everywhere 🌿
updates.body: Potted plants in Grind Café, the rooms and your home now grow real leaves and stay green all year, and the palms on the beach and at the airport have proper fronds.

updates.title: McGrind: serve what's ready
updates.body: Tap Serve to hand a customer whatever of their order is on the pass now; they pay when the last item arrives. No two people in the line share a name, and the shift tells you what is still to cook. The way into the kitchen is wider, under a Staff sign.

updates.title: Cabs and trains, fixed
updates.body: Grind Cabs are green with a lit roof sign, wait behind traffic instead of driving into it and keep to city speed; the move stick hides while you ride. Every Metro station now has a ticket hall with machines and real stairs up to the platform.

updates.title: Grind Mall, refreshed 🛒
updates.body: Real groceries on the Grind Fresh shelves, trolleys with shopping in them, a mall that looks like glass from the street too, a roomier walk by the cinema, and an actual film on the big screen: Night Market.

updates.title: Inside the Wellness house
updates.body: Walk in: a salon with stylists at work, a quiet counselling room and a skin and dental clinic, each with its people and its tools. Walk up to a room to book.

updates.title: Your drone is back, with a camera 🎥
updates.body: A drone you buy in Gadgets now flies beside you. Tap Fly the drone camera to film yourself from the air while you walk: take photos or record videos for your socials, saved to My Gallery.

updates.title: Grind Zoo: seven new animals 🐅
updates.body: Rhinos, hippos in the water hole, a crocodile on the bank, ostriches, cheetahs, tigers and a family of gorillas have joined the giraffes, zebras, elephants, lions and flamingos at Grind Park.

updates.title: Pray in the row, with everyone
updates.body: At the Grand Masjid the imam and the whole congregation now stand, bow, prostrate and sit together, and you take your place in the row beside them. Prayer mats everywhere point to the qibla.

updates.title: Fly your drone anywhere 🚁
updates.body: Drone camera now flies free: the stick flies it over the city, drag to turn, hold ▲ ▼ to climb, and ⌂ brings it back. Take photos or record video from up there.

updates.title: Mirrors, hippos and a tidier menu
updates.body: Real mirrors in the salon, rounder hippos in a bigger water hole, Grind Café shelves with coffee bags and pastries, lighter cushions at home, a shorter title card on phones, and every menu key (Seasons too) from the start. No confetti in places of prayer.
